summary: Jiuzi Holdings, Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the dismissal of its independent auditor, Audit Alliance LLP, effective June 22, 2026, and the engagement of Li CPA LLC as its new independent auditor for the fiscal year ending October 31, 2026. Both actions were approved by the Audit Committee and Board. The change was not due to any disagreements or reportable events. The filing is a routine auditor change and does not constitute a special situation. No deal terms are applicable.
